lines: d31: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jayden Foley is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d31: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d31: 🕯️ Jayden Foley is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d31: What Jayden kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d31: "Jayden's gone." Lena looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Jayden." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d31: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Robin blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d31: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d31: 📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
d31: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d31: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Jayden Foley, 31 days. The mantle passes to Robin Schmid.
d31: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Robin Schmid, 21 — a florist. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally, Beard Moss.
d31: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d31: The village's quarrel was with Jayden — and Jayden is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d31: At the grave, Ernestine, Easton, Ugur and 4 more speak for Robin — "Jayden trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d31: The fire knew Robin before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
